description: Tutorial T1 played start to finish with ONLY touch input (TouchInputAdapter, real ScreenTouch/ScreenDrag events): menu -> Tutorial -> Play; touch-worded prompts ('two fingers', '[Info]', '[?]', '[All]'); two-finger pan + pinch tick the camera checklist; Info opens the datasheet, Esc closes it; ? opens the touch cheat sheet; All grabs all 11 grots and one finger drags them; the summary shows the touch bullet list.

steps.script:
TouchInputAdapter.set_enabled(true)
return TouchInputAdapter.enabled
return TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap_node('/root/MainMenu/ScrollContainer/MenuContainer/ButtonSection/SecondaryButtonGrid/TutorialButton')
return TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap_node('/root/MainMenu/TutorialPicker/Margin/VBox/LessonRows/Row_t1_basics/Play_t1_basics')
return TutorialManager.active
return TutorialManager.current_step_id() == 'welcome'
return TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap_text("Continue", true)

TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, Vector2(900,600), true)
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(1, Vector2(1000,600), true)
return true

TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, Vector2(900,600), true)
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(1, Vector2(1000,600), true)
return true

TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, Vector2(900,600), true)
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(1, Vector2(1000,600), true)
return true

TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, Vector2(900,600), true)
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(1, Vector2(1000,600), true)
return true

TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, Vector2(920,600), true)
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(1, Vector2(980,600), true)
return true

TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, Vector2(850,600), true)
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(1, Vector2(1050,600), true)
return true

TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap(TouchInputAdapter.toolbar_button_center('Touch_Info'))
return true
return TutorialManager.current_step_id() == 'close_datasheet'

TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap(TouchInputAdapter.toolbar_button_center('Touch_Esc'))
return true
return TutorialManager.current_step_id() == 'log_panel'

TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap(TouchInputAdapter.toolbar_button_center('Touch_Help'))
return true
return TutorialManager.current_step_id() == 'controls_reference_close'
return TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap_node('/root/TouchInputAdapter/TouchHelpLayer/TouchHelpPanel/VBox/TouchHelpClose')
return TutorialManager.current_step_id() == 'end_phase_intro'
return TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap_text("Continue", true)

TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap(TouchInputAdapter.toolbar_button_center('Touch_All'))
return true

var mc = tree.current_scene.movement_controller
return mc.active_unit_id == 'U_GRETCHIN_T' and mc.selected_models.size() == 11

var mp = GameState.state.units['U_GRETCHIN_T'].models[0].position
var p = tree.current_scene.get_node('BoardRoot').get_global_transform_with_canvas() * Vector2(mp.x, mp.y)
TouchInputAdapter.set_meta('g', p)
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, p, true)
return true

TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, TouchInputAdapter.get_meta('g') + Vector2(0, 60), false)
return true
return TutorialManager.current_step_id() == 'confirm_grots'
return TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap_text("End This Unit's Move", true)
return TutorialManager.current_step_id() == 'wrap'
return TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap_text("Continue", true)
